title: A hollow mesoporous magnetic silica-based nanocomposite supported on copper ferrite functionalized with phosphomolybdic acid as a nanocatalyst for the synthesis of 1,4-dihydropyridines
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48937-48949
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06191A, Paper
Open Access

In this study, hollow nanocatalyst magnetic mesoporous has been prepared and characterized. This catalyst was used in reactions to synthesize 1,4-dihydropyridin derivatives.
